name: Martinique
prevalence_note: Martinique's economy and labour directorate (DEETS) warns about "Ping Call" callback scams, and French national guidance covers fake parcel SMS reported on the island.
cross_border_note: Martinique (+596) receives mainland French (+33) calls and calls from foreign premium numbers used in ping-call scams.

scams.name: Ping Call : appel manqué surtaxé
scams.name_en: Ping-call scam: a one-ring missed call baiting a costly callback
scams.signals_en: A single ring from an unknown, often foreign number leaves a missed call meant to make the owner call back at a premium rate.
scams.legit_en: DEETS Martinique advises not calling back unknown numbers after a one-ring missed call.
bait_tactics: Ne pas rappeler et noter l'heure de l'appel manqué
Signaler le numéro à l'opérateur mobile local

scams.name: SMS piège colis non livré
scams.name_en: Fake undelivered-parcel SMS with a relay-point link in Martinique

red_flag_keywords.text: régler les frais via le lien

scams.signals_en: An SMS reports a parcel that could not be delivered and asks for a fee or a relay-point choice through a link.
scams.legit_en: French cyber-assistance guidance says to ignore such links and check delivery only on the carrier's official site.
bait_tactics: Demander quel relais de Fort-de-France est concerné
Dire qu'on ira au guichet de La Poste avec l'avis papier
